name: temple_of_ahnqiraj
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 531 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json). The boss order is the usual clear order, the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss; walls, doors, stairs and events are unknown to it. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.
Raid plan: 40 players, the tank/healer/dps split is a placeholder. dungeon_run has no raid driver yet; the file is data for the raid leader.
Needs: Ouro (15517) has no spawn row: summoned from the mound (SPELL_SUMMON_OURO)
Needs: Skeram's gate (GO_SKERAM_GATE), the twin emperors' doors (GO_TWINS_ENTER_DOOR, GO_TWINS_EXIT_DOOR)
Merithra (15378), Caelestrasz (15379) and Arygos (15380) stand in C'Thun's antechamber, the Master's Eye (15963) is a mob; none is a leg.
